Word counter Count words, characters, paragraphs and reading time as you write.
Text case converter Convert text to sentence case, title case, uppercase or lowercase.
Reverse text Reverse graphemes, words or lines without breaking emoji.
Keyword density checker Measure single-word frequency and exact phrase occurrences in your text.
Base64 encode / decode Encode and decode UTF-8 text. Base64 is an encoding, not encryption.
JPG to PNG converter Convert a JPG image into a downloadable PNG without uploading it.
Image to WebP converter Create a WebP copy and choose the quality setting.
WebP to PNG converter Convert a WebP image into a PNG copy in your browser.
Resize image Set image dimensions while optionally preserving the aspect ratio.
Compress image Create a smaller JPEG or WebP copy and compare output size.
Rotate image Rotate by 90, 180 or 270 degrees without clipping the image.
Crop image Choose an exact pixel rectangle and download the cropped image.
Image to black and white Create a grayscale copy while retaining transparency in PNG output.
Image alt checker Inspect pasted HTML for missing, empty and descriptive image alt attributes.
HEX to RGB Convert 3-, 4-, 6- or 8-digit hexadecimal colors to RGB or RGBA.
PX to REM Convert pixels to rem using the root font size you specify.
Length converter Convert meters, centimeters, millimeters, kilometers, inches and feet.
Temperature converter Convert Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin with absolute-zero validation.
File size converter Convert decimal and binary storage units with an explicit unit basis.
Twitter card generator Generate escaped summary or large-image card meta tags.
Open Graph generator Generate page-sharing tags with validated URLs and image description.
JSON-LD structure checker Check JSON-LD syntax, context, type and common structural fields.
Schema generator Create Organization, Article, BreadcrumbList or FAQPage JSON-LD.
AMP validator Validate pasted HTML with the official AMP project's validator.
AEO, GEO and SEO checker Check a public page URL or pasted HTML for search optimization, answer readiness and signals useful to generative search. Get three checklists with practical fixes.
Domain name length checker Check domain and label lengths, including the ASCII form of internationalized names. No availability lookup.
Competitor backlink analyzer Analyze a CSV export from your backlink provider locally. No live crawl is performed.
Keyword suggestion tool Build question and intent-based keyword ideas from a seed topic, without invented search volumes.
Catalogue Domain Rating lookup Look up owner-supplied scores in the active marketplace. Not live Ahrefs measurements.
Link outreach planner Prepare a relevant outreach brief and qualified link markup. This does not create external backlinks.
